title: Network Core
summary: In-place WebSocket transport for authoritative rooms: single-threaded server and client on a pruned MIT libwebsockets, a browser client on the Emscripten WebSocket API, a bounded little-endian codec, and the HELLO version gate, message and queue limits, and rate limit every room shares.
dependencies: vendored libwebsockets v4.5.8 (MIT) for native builds, TLS off
provides: nt::network_core CMake target (server + client natively, client on web)
nt::network_core_codec CMake target (codec only, every platform)
net_ws_client.h: net_ws_client_create/service/send on native and web
net_codec.h: bounded reader/writer, fixed-point grids and 16-bit headings, HELLO, NET_CLOSE_* codes

flags.runtime: none; the transport is compiled in wherever the target is linked
